title: Sanitary Tees on Horizontal Waste Lines
description: Installing a standard sanitary tee in a horizontal-to-horizontal waste pipe line transition is a frequent plumbing mistake. Sanitary tees are engineered specifically to direct flow from a horizontal branch into a vertical stack. When installed horizontally, the short sweep does not adequately direct solids in the direction of flow, leading to waste accumulation, turbulence, and frequent clogs. For horizontal transitions, codes require a combination wye and eighth bend or a long-sweep turn to maintain smooth flow velocity and prevent blockages. Always verify fitting orientation and local code requirements during installation.

Sanitary Tees on Horizontal Waste Lines

Installing a standard sanitary tee in a horizontal-to-horizontal waste pipe line transition is a frequent plumbing mistake. Sanitary tees are engineered specifically to direct flow from a horizontal branch into a vertical stack. When installed horizontally, the short sweep does not adequately direct solids in the direction of flow, leading to waste accumulation, turbulence, and frequent clogs. For horizontal transitions, codes require a combination wye and eighth bend or a long-sweep turn to maintain smooth flow velocity and prevent blockages. Always verify fitting orientation and local code requirements during installation.
